id: title:fasyy612:correct recording timestamps for device clock skew

review.posthog_relevance: Adds telemetry and regression tests for clock skew correction in session replay, supporting debugging and reliability of timeline reconstruction.
review.reason: This chunk provides the implementation, telemetry, and tests for clock skew correction. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 establish the histogram and observation recording, while P1.F2.H1 establishes the test coverage. This demonstrates a bounded, substantive improvement in reliability and observability for session replay, warranting a score of 2. The chunk does not include the actual clock-sk
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the clock skew correction, the removal of the unmeasured counter, or the complete pipeline execution. It only includes the metrics, the tests, and the helper functions. Without the implementation, the tier cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Adds a histogram to record the absolute clock skew correction actually applied to rrweb timestamps.
observations.code_quote: help: 'Absolute clock skew correction actually applied to rrweb timestamps, per message. Quantized, so it differs from the raw offset in message_clock_skew_seconds',
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to distinguish between the raw clock offset and the correction applied, supporting debugging and reliability of session replay timelines.

observations.behavior: Adds a static method to record the clock skew correction observation.
observations.posthog_connection: Records the correction applied, not the raw offset, for telemetry and debugging.

observations.behavior: Adds a comprehensive test suite for clock skew correction, including cases for device ahead, device behind, and unmeasured scenarios.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection and demonstrates the expected behavior of the clock skew correction, including the ability to leave well-behaved clocks untouched and not reorder events.
